spells.name: Apex Predator
spells.note: Window marker for the Ravage/Mutilate flurry — server-side dummy with no events, so it never produces a failure.

spells.name: Melee
spells.note: Informational only — the boss melees whoever holds threat, so non-tank hits mean the tank died or lost aggro, not that the hit player failed.

spells.name: Corroding Venom
spells.note: Cast/aura ID; the player-facing stacking debuff is 1282873.

spells.name: Corroding Venom
spells.note: 12s stacking tank debuff, +3% Physical damage taken per stack — one of the two tank-swap drivers; Wowhead lists no dispel type.

spells.name: Ravage
spells.note: 3s cast ID for the Physical frontal cone; the damage ID is 1277101.

spells.name: Ravage
spells.note: Physical frontal damage that also stacks +300% Ravage damage taken for 25s — any non-tank hit is a facing failure.

spells.name: Mutilate
spells.note: Cast ID for the venom frontal cone; the damage ID is 1277031.

spells.name: Mutilate
spells.note: Nature frontal split evenly among everyone struck, so it is a soak rather than a failure — report bodies-per-cast, not a per-player blame list.

spells.name: Mutilated Gash
spells.note: 22s Nature DoT applied to every Mutilate soaker; Wowhead lists no dispel type, so it is healing pressure, not a dispel.

spells.name: Mutilated Gash
spells.note: Damage ID of the Gash DoT — 8 killing blows on Mythic PTR, so attribute deaths but never count ticks as failures.

spells.name: Tempest
spells.note: Cast ID for the poisonous wind vortices; the player-facing debuff is 1287083.

spells.name: Tempest
spells.note: Nature DoT and -30% run speed from touching a vortex; genuinely Poison-dispellable per Wowhead and log-confirmed by 76 healer removals (Cleanse, Nature's Cure).

spells.name: Venomous Surge
spells.note: Cast ID; the target debuff is 1305963 and the burst damage is 1306120.

spells.name: Venomous Surge
spells.note: 10s target marker that names the cyst carriers; Wowhead lists no dispel type, so being picked is not a failure.

spells.name: Venomous Surge
spells.note: Burst damage that falls off with distance — a hit on anyone who did not carry 1305963 means they failed to clear the carrier.

spells.name: Viscous Cyst
spells.note: Spawn ID for the 2min toxin glob dropped when Venomous Surge expires; the burst is 1287205.

spells.name: Viscous Cyst
spells.note: Cyst burst — Nature damage, a DoT and -30% speed; any hit means someone walked into a glob.

spells.name: Caustic Claws
spells.note: Nature damage in a 6yd impact radius that leaves a Caustic Residue pool — listed as Heroic+ by Wowhead and warcraft.wiki.gg.

spells.name: Caustic Residue
spells.note: Ground-area ID that produces no player events — the player-facing debuff is 1296667.

spells.name: Caustic Residue
spells.note: Standing in the acid: damage per second plus +30% damage taken from all schools, and Wowhead confirms no dispel type.

spells.name: Ula'tek's Presence
spells.note: Aura ID for the altar's caustic haze; the damage ID is 1285965.

spells.name: Ula'tek's Presence
spells.note: Unavoidable raid-wide Nature attrition for the whole fight — the healing check, never a player failure.

spells.name: Raging Crosswinds
spells.note: Altar cast that imbues several players with winds; the direction debuffs and the expiry damage are separate IDs.

spells.name: Raging Crosswinds
spells.note: 8s wind-direction debuff — a marker naming who is about to be knocked and which way, not a failure.

spells.name: Raging Crosswinds
spells.note: Second 8s wind-direction debuff — same marker role as 1285425.

spells.name: Raging Crosswinds
spells.note: Third wind direction, seen only on Mythic PTR — Mythic-only status is inferred from log counts, not stated by any guide.

spells.name: Raging Crosswinds
spells.note: Fourth wind direction, seen only on Mythic PTR — same inference as 1297096.

spells.name: Raging Crosswinds
spells.note: Expiry explosion that damages and knocks back everyone in the strike area — any hit means someone failed to spread.

spells.name: Turbulent Gusts
spells.note: 10s aloft state (slow fall, no inertia) that dissipates if two carriers collide — the state itself is expected, deaths land under Falling.

spells.name: Howling Maelstrom
spells.note: Phase marker for the succession of directional gales; no cast events on PTR, so detect the phase via Dig In.

spells.name: Dig In
spells.note: The fight's only burn window — Sszorak is immovable and takes +30% damage for 25s during Howling Maelstrom.

spells.name: Falling
spells.note: Environmental fall death after a wind knock — 31 killing blows across 6 Mythic PTR pulls, more than every boss ability combined.

spells.name: Serpent's Fury
spells.note: Marks a player and builds rage; warcraft.wiki.gg confirms 14+ players within 8yd of the mark forces To the Slaughter and spends the rage.

spells.name: Serpent's Fury
spells.note: The mark debuff naming who the raid stacks on.

spells.name: To the Slaughter
spells.note: The charge the raid deliberately forces — attribute deaths only, since being struck is the intended outcome.

spells.name: Virulence
spells.note: 5s Nature DoT from the charge that bursts and spreads to nearby players on removal; Wowhead lists no dispel type.

spells.name: Virulence
spells.note: Second Virulence aura ID with the same profile.

spells.name: Unbound Ferocity
spells.note: Soft enrage at 100 rage (+500% damage, +50% attack speed) — a single application ends the pull.
